prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1184; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of the insured has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any claim file materials. Destruction or alteration of such material could result in serious consequences for your insured and for the carrier. We look forward to your prompt written response.
